_about: Keeps the land around structures clear (docs/lived-in.md, 'Keeping the land clear'; mod/ keepclear). trees: structures whose pieces keep TFC's and ArborFirmaCraft's trees, bushes, fallen logs and boulders out (no trunk within 'solid' blocks of a piece's box, thinning out to 'margin'). holds: structures whose pieces keep the pieces of 'yields' structures out (a piece is not placed where its box, widened by hold_pad sideways, hold_depth below and hold_up above, meets a held piece). Natural things other mods place as 'structures' (trees, log piles, boulders) neither keep trees out nor hold.
